entry.title: Context Engineering for AI Agents: Why the Build Is Easy and the Context Is Not (2026)
entry.summary: Verdict: In 2026, building a working AI agent is close to a solved problem. Durable state, sandboxed execution, and observability are now platform primitives, not quarter-long engineering projects. What still breaks agents in production is not the model and not the scaffolding.
